"A chaotic injection will cause localized systems to fail in unpredictable ways—not just power fluctuations. We could crash the medical stabilizer grid or lose filtration flow in Gamma Cache."

Before you can respond, the entire station groans. Ren’s console flashes a violent orange warning—a massive counter-signal has been generated by the Entity in response to your query, even before any code was run.
